headline_pain: Rent Going Up Again This Year?
primary_text: "I'm paying more in rent every year and getting nothing to show for it. Dead money." Sound familiar? You're not alone — hundreds of small businesses in Melbourne's west are watching profits disappear into someone else's pocket. Our off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina let you swap rent for ownership. Lock in today's price, settle when it's built, and start building equity instead of enriching a landlord. Located minutes from Princes Freeway and the West Gate Tunnel. Purpose-built for owner-occupiers, not investors. Limited units in the size range small businesses actually need.
description: Stop paying dead money — own a brand-new Truganina warehouse and build equity from day one.
